summary: Flat fee pricing is a strong selling point, but the fee placeholders and appointment wording appear to cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: Every flat fee appears to read [Fee] call for current flat fee, so the prices that make the firm stand out are missing.
findings.cost: Clients comparing flat fee lawyers may leave for a firm that shows a price.
findings.fix: Real fee ranges or a from price on each service.

findings.problem: The logo and footer practice links appear to point to # and page anchors, so every practice area in the footer goes to the same place.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot reach a page for their specific matter.
findings.fix: One page per practice area with its own link.

findings.problem: Hours appear as Monday to Friday 9:00 to 17:30 while other text says by appointment only and walk-in notary service.
findings.cost: Mixed messages make people unsure whether to call, visit or book.
findings.fix: One clear rule for hours, walk-ins and appointments.

findings.problem: No lawyer name, photo, credentials, reviews or results appear to be shown.
findings.cost: People hire a lawyer they can see and trust.
findings.fix: A named lawyer profile and visible client reviews.

redesign: Lawyer profile, reviews and a booking form.
